Method of Attack: Cross-site scripting (XSS) via the xmlattr filter when keys containing spaces are used, allowing injection of arbitrary HTML attributes.
Discoverer: Calum Hutton from the Snyk security research team
Impacted Systems: Projects using Jinja2 versions prior to 3.1.3
Attack Vector: User input containing keys with spaces passed to the xmlattr filter, bypassing auto-escaping mechanisms.
